gold: Cutaneous Bacillus cereus infection with bacteremia

selector.rationale: Evidence of gram-variable rods and clinical presentation of vesicles with erythematous base, consistent with ecthyma gangrenosum, a characteristic skin lesion of Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection, particularly in neutropenic patients.

rejected.label: Nectrotizing fasciitis
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence for necrotizing fasciitis, such as extensive soft tissue necrosis or gas in tissues

rejected.label: Bacillus anthracis infection
rejected.why: No definitive evidence for anthrax, such as cutaneous eschar or systemic symptoms consistent with anthrax

rejected.label: Neutropenic sepsis
rejected.why: While patient is neutropenic and septic, this diagnosis does not specifically explain the skin lesions
